verdict.rationale: Docs confirm registration creation, filings retrieval, and marketing copy claiming Kintsugi 'registers you and files everywhere you sell,' indicating automated filing/remittance across jurisdictions. However, there is no explicit documentation of an on-time filing guarantee or penalty-coverage commitment, nor independent evidence corroborating the claim. missing for 10: explicit vendor guarantee/penalty-coverage terms, evidence of remittance execution (not just filing), independent/hands-on confirmation of on-time filing performance.
